scope: Fictional English PDFs for retrieval and grounding checks, no agricultural recommendations.

documents.title: Synthetic nursery reference
documents.body: The fictional nursery register uses a blue tray marker. Its crop-history checklist records the preceding crop.

documents.title: Synthetic irrigation reference
documents.body: The fictional irrigation log records soil texture and recent moisture. It leaves the next watering date blank.

documents.title: Synthetic soil reference
documents.body: The fictional soil report groups phosphorus and potassium under baseline measurements. Its report identifier is TEST-SOIL.

documents.title: Synthetic drainage reference
documents.body: The fictional drainage sketch labels the east channel as the outlet. It does not specify a channel depth.

documents.title: Synthetic field-study reference
documents.body: The fictional field study counted tagged plants and measured harvested pod weight. The site was named Example Plot.

documents.title: Synthetic polytunnel reference
documents.body: The fictional polytunnel study compared hydroponic and soil media. Its methods list pH and conductivity measurements.
